originalTitle: Watch: At the scene of Spain's deadly train crash
summary: People have been killed after a Spanish high-speed train collided with another train south of the capital Madrid, making this the country's worst disaster since 2013.
content:
Dozens of people have died and others have been injured after two high-speed trains collided south of the Spanish capital Madrid.

Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said it was "unacceptable" that Spain had suffered its second fatal rail crash in a year.

The BBC's Guy Hedgecoe reports from the scene of the crash.
chineseTitle: 观看：西班牙致命火车事故现场
chineseSummary: 西班牙一列高铁在首都马德里以南与另一列火车相撞，造成人员死亡，这是该国自2013年以来最严重的灾难。
chineseContent:
西班牙首都马德里以南两列高铁相撞，造成数十人死亡、多人受伤。

西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯表示，西班牙一年内遭遇第二次致命铁路事故“令人无法接受”。

英国广播公司 (BBC) 的盖伊·赫奇科 (Guy Hedgecoe) 在坠机现场进行报道。
